name: gripterm-monorepo
description: Workspace root for the Gripterm extension. Not published.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension && tsc -p tsconfig.eslint.json && jest
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension && tsc -p tsconfig.eslint.json && jest --coverage
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension && pnpm run build:integration && vscode-test
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension && pnpm --filter gripterm run package
scripts.test:acceptance: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension && tsc -p tsconfig.acceptance.json && node tests/acceptance/run.mjs
scripts.test:stand: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension && pnpm run build:stand && node tests/stand/run.mjs
